name: Rin Chunshuen
source:
She was born in the winter of 1980 and raised in northern China. Since early childhood, she has struggled with a congenital heart defect (atrial septal defect). She was told that she wouldn't live to be 20. 

Over several years, thanks to her family's efforts, she underwent many operations, yet none of them succeeded. Because she didn't have many opportunities to attend school regularly, she has developed an introverted personality and has become a loner. She used to practice [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Para_Para]Para Para[/url] dance for a long time, but with the worsening of her illness, she has not been able to engage in any intense physical activity.

After losing her family in the 1998 flood, she decided to accept [url=https://vndb.org/c159276]Kou Shamo's[/url] suggestion and come to Japan, although she barely spoke Japanese.
